name: persistence-failure-before-tool
purpose: The write of the tool-call turn fails; the turn ends with an error and no tool runs.
guide: 7.2: a persistence failure before tool execution

upstream.procedure: After the server logs request 0, make state.db unwritable (for example chmod a-w on the file and its -wal and -shm files) before the tool runs, then check that the tool did not run.
